test_title: PYST 06: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following are the requisite qualifications of Supreme Court judges?

1) He should be a citizen of India.

2) He should have been a High Court judge for five years or should have been a High Court advocate for ten years.

3) He should be a distinguished jurist in the opinion of the President.

4) He should be a minimum of 35 years old.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1, 2 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• To be appointed as a judge of the **Supreme Court of India**, an individual must meet certain qualifications.
 
• The individual should be a **citizen of India**.
 
• The individual should have served as a **High Court judge for at least five years** or should have been an **advocate in a High Court for at least ten years**.
 
• The individual could also be a **distinguished jurist** in the opinion of the **President of India**.
 
• There is no specific age requirement mentioned for the Supreme Court judgeship in the **Constitution of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Distinguished Jurist**

 
 
• A **distinguished jurist** is someone who is recognized for their exceptional knowledge and expertise in the field of law.
 
• The **President of India** has the discretion to appoint a distinguished jurist as a judge of the **Supreme Court**.
 
• This provision allows for the inclusion of highly respected legal scholars and academicians in the judiciary.
 
 
 
• **High Court Judge**
 
 
• Being a **High Court judge** for at least five years is one of the qualifications for appointment as a **Supreme Court judge**.
 
• High Court judges are appointed by the **President of India** in consultation with the **Chief Justice of India** and the **Governor of the respective state**.
 
 
 
• **High Court Advocate**
 
 
• Having been an **advocate in a High Court for at least ten years** is another qualification for appointment as a **Supreme Court judge**.
 
• Advocates practicing in High Courts are usually well-versed in legal procedures and have substantial courtroom experience.
